note: Read `bench/README-speech-eval.md` before quoting any number produced from this file. Each entry is one thing a guest actually says at a hotel front desk, chosen so the set covers the failure modes that cost money rather than the ones that look good in a demo. `id` is the audio filename stem; `ref` is the ground truth; `why` says what this line is here to catch. 2026-09-05: expanded from 22 cases (10 vi, 2-4 each other language) to 60 (10 per language, same 10 scenarios translated), so per-language STT/TTS numbers rest on the same sample size instead of comparing n=10 against n=2.
